body.name: Hstar
body.type: The explicit cyclic directed cluster graph on \(C_{\star}\).
body.def: \(H_{\star}\) has precisely \(K_a\to K_b\), \(K_a\to K_{cd}\), \(K_{cd}\to K_a\), \(K_b\to K_{cd}\), and \(K_{cd}\to K_b\), with no bidirected edges.
body.role: Excluded cyclic cluster input for the strict collision result.
